title: Quality of medical expert opinions on legal guardianship in guardianship law on the question of free will (legal) capacity
summary: Retrospective analysis of 500 guardianship reports from Lower Saxony courts from 2020-2024 to assess the way in which questions relating to free will formation are handled by the experts.
conditions: Study to evaluate the approaches of medical experts on a specific topic

interventions.name: 500 medical expert opinions on legal guardianship of the years 2020-2024

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Expert opinions on legal guardianship of the years 2020 to 2024
Exclusion criteria:
No reports from the judicial districts that belong to the Braunschweig Higher Regional Court, as the head of the study himself works as an expert here. No reports prepared by the study director. Only reports from lower saxonia.
